data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Rheanne', meaning 'Reborn'. In Greek mythology, Rhea was the goddess of the harvest and the mother of Zeus. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rennie usually hope their child will grow to embody reborn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
